body:
When I update UV with Scoop, it is blocked by ESET Internet Security's "PUA blacklist," preventing the update.

Affected requests: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.13.0/uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip


title: [Antivirus interception]UV has been blacklisted by ESET as a PUA.
